messages.subject: Has anyone tested performance with Revolution Open R?
parts:
Hi,

Has anyone tested performance of Shiny with Revolution Open R?  

http://www.revolutionanalytics.com/revolution-r-open

I suppose performance benefits should large come from use cases that rely on matrix and vector operations.  I know I could install this on my own box running shiny server/R and test things out, but figured I'd ask about others' experiences before I take any time.

Does anyone familiar with the inner workings of Shiny have any insight to the benefits/drawbacks of using Revolution Open R?

Erik
